notes: Branch 1 writes no names after the ح, so the names after the last ح belong to branch 2 only and no tail is shared. Doubt: branch 1 ends at Jarir with no Companion written.
«قال عثمان الهمداني عن عبد الله بن عمر» is read as a link (rule 5): Uthman is the source of Abdullah b. Murra.
«قال مسدد قال رسول الله» and «ثم اتفقا» are wording remarks and are left out.
